issue.title: test_models_panel_usage_120_columns_png_snapshot: State column captured one cell narrow under the saturated visual lane
issue.description:
FOUND BY the sase-y5.12 land agent while triaging the epic's `just check-full && just test-visual` landing gate on 2026-09-09 at master HEAD cef06cdca. This node's golden is the sase-y5 subscription-capacity surface's own snapshot, rebaselined by d165fbbaa, so it is recorded here rather than folded into the generic visual-lane debt.

The failure is a column-width convergence race in the Providers - Usage table, not a content change. In the failing frame the State column is one cell narrower than the golden: `exhausted` renders truncated as `exhaust` and the Source column shifts one cell left, giving 26k changed pixels. Every other row (the CODEX/GROK capacity bars, `Status: ok - Last observed: 2027-01-15 03:00:00 EST (0s ago)`, the Window/Remaining/Scope/Reset/Age values, and the footer key hints) is byte-identical, which is what distinguishes this from the stale goldens tracked by sase-x5. The frame appears to be captured before the table's final width negotiation settles.

Same class as sase-wh, sase-vo, and sase-sm: a visual node that only fails when the PNG lane is saturated.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once inside the full 14-worker just test-visual run on 2026-09-09 (35 failed / 862 passed, 231s wall, on a host the check-full test-cost gate had already flagged as contended), then passed on the unchanged tree when the 35 failing node IDs were re-run in isolation (33 failed / 2 passed, 28s). Observed fail rate 1 of 2 parallel-lane runs, 0 of 1 reduced-load runs. The diff is a one-cell State column narrowing (exhausted rendered as exhaust) with every other cell identical, which is a width-convergence race rather than a content change.
